_comment: Soundboard script for tools/gen-audio.mjs. Original lines only, never the book's boxed text (the repo is public). Write lines the way people talk; [tags] are performed by eleven_v4. A clip's file is assets/audio/<id>.mp3; delete it to regenerate. A voice with no id is skipped until it has one. The team's fixer is voiced live by the GM.

clips.label: SFX: armoured truck on the road
clips.sfx: A heavy armoured truck driving fast on a wet highway at night, diesel engine roaring past

clips.label: SFX: firing from the gunports
clips.sfx: Submachine gun bursts fired from inside a metal truck through gunports, muffled and echoing

clips.label: Aztech guard: contact!
clips.text: [shouting] Contact rear! Contact rear! [banging on metal] Driver, punch it — get us out of here!

clips.label: Aztech guard: open the ports
clips.text: [urgent] Open the ports, open the ports! [grunts] Light 'em up!

clips.label: Aztech guard: calling it in
clips.text: [into radio, breathless] Convoy six to base — [shouting over gunfire] we're under attack, I repeat, under attack! [desperate] Requesting immediate support!

clips.label: Aztech guard: we give
clips.text: [coughing] Okay, okay! We're out! [beat] It's not worth it, man. It's not our cyber.

clips.label: SFX: DocWagon van
clips.sfx: A small electric delivery van pulling away in city traffic, light hum and horn honk

clips.label: Courier: hands up
clips.text: [nervous laugh] Put my hands up and step out of the car? Yes, sir! [quickly] Absolutely, sir. Happening right now.

clips.label: Courier: just take it
clips.text: [nervous] Look — just take it, okay? [shaky] It's a box. [babbling] It's a cold box. I don't even know what's in it. [pleading] I just drive.

clips.label: Courier: please don't shoot
clips.text: [panicked] Please don't shoot me. [voice cracking] I've got a kid, man. I've got a kid.

playlists.name: DE Soundboard — Run 3: The Worst Kind of Mail

clips.label: SFX: McHugh's dive bar (loop)
clips.sfx: A grimy dive bar at night: low murmur of rough voices, clinking glasses, an old jukebox playing faintly, a pool ball break

clips.label: Read-aloud: McHugh's
clips.text: [low] McHugh's is the kind of bar where nobody looks up when the door opens. [pause] Except the man at the corner table. Clean haircut, clean suit... he doesn't belong here, and he doesn't care who knows it.

clips.label: Juárez: my name is
clips.text: [quietly] Sit down. [pause] My name is Special Agent Simon Juárez. [beat] And yes — I know exactly who you are.

clips.label: Juárez: I know what you did
clips.text: The Aztechnology truck. The DocWagon case. [flatly] It's all documented. Every frame of it. [pause] You've been busy.

clips.label: Juárez: relax
clips.text: [sighs] Relax. If I wanted you in a cell, you'd already be in one. [beat] I'd much rather you did me a favour.

clips.label: Juárez: you're deniable
clips.text: [low, flat] Let's get one thing straight. [pause] You're not my partners. [cold] You're deniable. [beat] [quietly] Something goes wrong in there, I've never heard of you.

clips.label: Juárez: Agent Ranger
clips.text: [tired] The last man I sent in was Clint Ranger. Good agent. [long pause] He stopped checking in three weeks ago.

clips.label: Juárez: we're not the only ones
clips.text: [low] And keep your heads down in there. [beat] The Bureau isn't the only one watching that camp.

playlists.name: DE Soundboard — Runs 4–5: Hope's Front Door

clips.label: SFX: enrollment centre crowd (loop)
clips.sfx: A crowded, dingy waiting room: shuffling feet, coughing, quiet sobbing, a buzzing fluorescent light, murmured conversations

clips.label: Read-aloud: the enrollment centre
clips.text: [quietly] The sign promises hope. [pause] The smell promises something else. A long line of the most desperate people you've ever seen sags against the wall... and a well-dressed woman behind a desk manages a plastic smile and waves you over.

clips.label: Montagu: welcome
clips.text: [brightly] Welcome to Project Hope! [warm] May I take your names? Don't worry, nobody here judges.

clips.label: Montagu: please, sit
clips.text: [warm, practiced] Please, have a seat. [gently] And if you have any trouble reading the form, [reassuring] that's perfectly all right — [brightly] we have a voice unit for that.

clips.label: Montagu: the pitch
clips.text: [practiced, cheerful] The camp offers three square meals a day, a clean bed, new clothes... and honest work. Gardening, light labour, even teaching. [pause] A fresh start.

clips.label: Montagu: a few questions
clips.text: Just a few questions. [typing] Any family? Any... [slight pause] medical implants we should know about? It's purely for your care, of course.

clips.label: Montagu: you've been selected
clips.text: [delighted] Wonderful news! You've been selected. [beat] The bus leaves at dawn. You'll want to be on it.

clips.label: SFX: the bus out
clips.sfx: An old overcrowded bus grinding along a broken road, rattling windows, a groaning engine, muffled coughing passengers

clips.label: Read-aloud: the bus ride
clips.text: [weary] Hours of broken road through the Barrens. No air conditioning. Windows that won't open. [pause] Then a fence rises out of the waste — barracks, bullet-scarred walls, and two big domed gates swinging open to swallow you.

clips.label: PEO: loudspeaker
clips.text: [over a loudspeaker, calm] Hope Relief Camp ahead. Please remain seated. [beat] Welcome home.

clips.label: PEO: step off the bus
clips.text: [calmly] Please step off the bus. Single file. [pause] Leave your bags on the ground in front of you.

clips.label: PEO: just a routine check
clips.text: Arms out, please. [scanner beeping] This is just a routine check. [pleasantly] There's nothing to be afraid of here.

clips.label: PEO: we'll hold onto that
clips.text: [mildly] We'll hold onto this for you. [beat] You won't be needing it. Not here.

clips.label: PEO: noted
clips.text: [pause, scanner chirps] Cyberware. Left arm. [quietly] Noted. Move along.

playlists.name: DE Soundboard — Run 6: Hope Relief Camp

clips.label: SFX: the camp by day (loop)
clips.sfx: A peaceful garden compound by day: songbirds, gentle wind in trees, distant quiet voices and a garden hoe working soil

clips.label: Read-aloud: the camp
clips.text: [slowly] It's beautiful. [pause] After the Barrens, the word feels obscene — but it fits. Trees. Flowers. Birdsong. People who look... content. [low] It should feel like relief. Instead it crawls up the back of your neck.

clips.label: Tung: welcome
clips.text: [warmly] Welcome, welcome! I'm Jonathan Tung — I run things here. [laughs softly] Anything you need, anything at all, you just ask me.

clips.label: Tung: how many people?
clips.text: Well, depends what you mean by here. [pleasant] Most people start at Hope for training, then move on to wherever their skills fit best. All together? [beat] Over two thousand, and growing every day.

clips.label: Tung: everyone belongs
clips.text: [gently] I know what the streets took from you. [sincere] Here, nobody is forgotten. Here, everyone belongs to something greater.

clips.label: Tung: we're a family
clips.text: [smiling] We're not a charity, really. [softly] We're a family. [pause] You'll see. Give it a few days.

clips.label: Tung: over the loudspeaker (after the raid)
clips.text: [over a loudspeaker, soothing] Good evening, everyone. There's been a small disturbance at the fence, but it's all taken care of now. [warm] Please, go back to sleep. You're safe here.

clips.label: SFX: truck through the fence
clips.sfx: A heavy truck smashing through a chain-link fence at night, metal screeching, then automatic gunfire and shouting

clips.label: Butcher: go, go, go!
clips.text: [shouting] Go, go, go! [laughing wildly] Grab everything that ain't nailed down!

clips.label: Butcher: what are they?
clips.text: [terrified] What the frag are those things? [screaming] They don't go down — they don't go down!

clips.label: Butcher: run!
clips.text: [panicked] Back to the truck! Run, run! [gasping] Leave 'em — just run!

clips.label: PEO: prisoners are a waste
clips.text: [flat, calm] No prisoners. [pause] Prisoners are a waste of resources.

clips.label: Stranger at breakfast: hi
clips.text: [friendly] Mind if I sit? [chuckles] Food's almost too good, right? I keep waiting for the catch.

clips.label: Stranger: seen anything strange?
clips.text: [leaning in, quietly] So... you seen anything strange around here? [beat] What do any of us really know about Project Hope?

clips.label: Read-aloud: the Medical Center
clips.text: [measured] The Medical Center is the cleanest thing for kilometres. White walls. Real equipment. Calm staff in scrubs, moving between the beds. [pause] It looks exactly like an honest charity clinic. [low] Which is precisely the problem.

clips.label: SFX: lower-level alarm
clips.sfx: A clinical electronic alarm tone pulsing in a sterile hallway, with an automated door locking

clips.label: PEO: unauthorised access
clips.text: [calm, over intercom] Unauthorised access on the lower level. [pause] All personnel, please remain where you are.

clips.label: Tung: you shouldn't be down here
clips.text: [still smiling, quietly] You shouldn't be down here. [pause] I'm disappointed. I really thought you'd be happy with us.

clips.label: Tung: you'll understand soon
clips.text: [serene, almost loving] Don't be afraid. [whispers] You'll understand soon. Everyone does, in the end.

clips.label: Read-aloud: New Dawn Environics
clips.text: [low] New Dawn looks like a research park that swallowed a fortress. Lawns, a babbling brook, songbirds... [pause] and a four-metre electrified fence, with hard-eyed guards who don't flinch when the birds land on their shoulders.

clips.label: Read-aloud: the treatment hall
clips.text: [tense] The smell hits first — chemical rot, and something worse. [pause] A hundred metres of brown sludge, popping and burbling. Then something floats to the surface. [whispers] It used to be a person.

clips.label: SFX: the sludge pool (loop)
clips.sfx: A huge vat of thick bubbling sludge in an echoing industrial hall, wet popping and gurgling, low machinery hum

clips.label: SFX: insect hiss
clips.sfx: A large insect hissing and clicking its mandibles aggressively, wet and close

clips.label: SFX: the Hive (loop)
clips.sfx: Dark underground insect hive ambience, constant low chittering and clicking of thousands of insects, wet organic sounds, a deep slow breathing

clips.label: Queen: little ones
clips.text: [slow, layered whisper] Little ones. [pause] You came so far to find me.

clips.label: Queen: lay down your weapons
clips.text: [hypnotic] Do not be afraid. [softly] Lay down your weapons... and rest.

clips.label: Queen: part of us
clips.text: You will never be alone again. [pause] You will be part of us. [whispers] Part of me.

clips.label: Queen: my children
clips.text: [rising, furious hiss] You dare? [roaring] My children! Protect your mother!

clips.label: Queen: wounded
clips.text: [shrieking, many voices] No! [hissing] This flesh... this flesh is not the end of me.
